notes: Total 72 pieces matching the parts list. The booklet minifigures (firefighter, woman) are not in the parts list and are omitted.

The remaining 2 groups are real, not an error: the booklet builds two separate models. Group 1 is the small tree scene (pages 3-4: jumper plate b1, pillar b2, leaves b3, cat b4, fish b5). Group 2 is the fire patrol car (pages 5-27). Nothing in the booklet connects the tree to the car (the car's minifigure sits inside the car, and the tree stands alone), so I deliberately did not invent a join between them.
The fish (b5) is linked loosely to the tree (b3) since page 4 step 3 shows it held beside the tree.
Page 8-9 rear light assembly and page 20 front grille assembly are built sideways (SNOT); those joins are recorded in other_joins, not rests_on.
Step 9 (side panel assembly) is built 2x: each copy is 52501 inverted slope, white 1x4 plate, red 15207 panel. Stickers are applied to the panels and roof (approximate).
Which exact lower pieces are clutched by some bricks (rear white plates, red edge plates, wheel arches, hood parts, windscreens) is inferred from small isometric drawings and is approximate.
Windscreens are held by the hinge plates (front) and rest on the rear red plate (rear); the roof sits on the windscreen top studs.
Wheels/tyres: 4 wheels pushed into 4 tyres, then onto the pins of the two 6157 wheel holders (b7 front, b8 rear).
